notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Deathbloom Ritualist.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
